theorems.name: Submission.regcomp_monotonicity_mass_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.HasLocallyBoundedMeanCurvature → ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C r₁ : ℝ, 0 < r₁ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < r₁ → R.measure (ball x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * r ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
